name: Always a Threat (Combat)
body:
You can be ready for a fight in an instant.

Prerequisites: Quick Draw.

Benefit(s): When carrying a light or one-handed melee weapon, even if it is sheathed or stowed you threaten adjacent squares in melee. Additionally, whenever an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you may draw a light or one-handed melee weapon as part of that attack of opportunity. The target of this attack is considered flat-footed. You must have at least one hand free to benefit from this feat.

Normal: If you are unarmed and do not possess the Improved Unarmed Strike feat you are not considered to be threatening adjacent squares in melee.
